_source: Story 058, decision D-069. Drawn frames that replace the cut-out rig for some clips, per character (the body's own sprite id, so a Vessel borrowing another's rig clips never borrows its drawings). Frames come from tools/art/slice_frames.gd (folder, frames.json with each frame's size and feet anchor). clips: for a rig clip name, the frames in order as [progress, frame] or [progress, frame, true] for a frame drawn the other way round (mirrored); a frame shows from its progress until the next. A clip with no entry here plays on the rig as before. nudge: pixels to move a frame sideways after anchoring (+ = forward), where the drawing's stance makes the feet anchor sit off the body.
